liu-bei:
Benevolence (Kindness in Dynasty Wars) needs three or more cards given in a turn to heal 1 HP, not two. It heals once per turn at most.
The Lord skill is not in Kingdom Wars.
zhuge-liang: Empty City can now be targeted. A Sha or Duel aimed at him while his hand is empty is cancelled and wasted. In Dynasty Wars he cannot be chosen at all.
huang-yueying: Assembling Wisdom draws only for a Tool you really use. A Tool converted from other cards, such as a Chains made by Pang Tong or a Blaze or Wuxie made by Younger Zhuge Liang, draws nothing. A Wuxie you play still draws.
gan-fu-ren: A new General for Kingdom Wars. Dynasty Wars has no General like this.
liu-shan: The Lord skill is not in Kingdom Wars.
pang-tong: Resurrection (Nirvana in Dynasty Wars) also clears his Chained state when he comes back.
zhu-rong: Fearsome Blade works only on a General your Sha was aimed at. Damage that reaches someone else, such as through Chains, does not trigger it.
cao-cao: The Lord skill is not in Kingdom Wars.
cao-pi: The Lord skill is not in Kingdom Wars.
guo-jia: Bequeathed Strategy no longer draws. He looks at the top two cards, gives one to any player, then gives the other to any player. Both can go to the same player, or to himself. Only he sees them.
xun-yu: Eternal Loyalty draws up to the lesser of the target's maximum HP and 5 cards. In Dynasty Wars there is no cap of 5.
yue-jin: A new General for Kingdom Wars. Dynasty Wars has no General like this.
zhen-ji: Goddess Luo keeps the black cards on the table until the judging ends, then she takes them all together. In Dynasty Wars each black card goes into her hand at once.
sun-quan:
Balance of Power (Reconsider in Dynasty Wars) can discard at most as many cards as his maximum HP, once per Play Phase. In Dynasty Wars there is no limit.
The Lord skill is not in Kingdom Wars.
ding-feng: A new General for Kingdom Wars. Dynasty Wars has no General like this.
lu-xun:
Scrutinize replaces Linked Camps. In his Play Phase he can use a red hand card as Amass, as often as he likes.
Humility can now be targeted. A Steal or Capture aimed at him is cancelled and wasted. In Dynasty Wars he cannot be chosen at all.
sun-shangxiang: Warrior Lady is optional. Each time cards leave her equipment area she may draw 2 cards, once per instance, so two pieces leaving together draw 2 in all. In Dynasty Wars it is compulsory and draws 2 per card.
zhang-zhao-and-zhang-hong: Stabilization replaces Stubborn. When another player ends their Discard Phase, they can give one card that player discarded back to them and, if they do, take every other card discarded that phase. It works even when only one card was discarded.
yuan-shao: The Lord skill is not in Kingdom Wars.
zhang-jiao:
Lightning Strike cannot pick himself. In Dynasty Wars any living player can be picked, himself included.
The Lord skill is not in Kingdom Wars.
diao-chan:
Seed of Animosity cannot be answered by Wuxie. In Dynasty Wars the Duel can be.
Envious Moon is optional. She may draw 1 card at her End Phase, where Dynasty Wars makes it compulsory.
cai-wenji: Sorrow makes the killer lose the skills of only one of their two Generals, which Cai Wenji's player picks. In Dynasty Wars the killer loses every skill.
jia-xu:
Behind the Curtain can now be targeted. A black Tool aimed at him is cancelled and wasted. In Dynasty Wars he cannot be chosen at all.
Descend into Chaos makes each other player play a Sha at the player nearest to them, or lose 1 HP. In Dynasty Wars they may pick anyone in attack range. It is still once per game.
